inputs.text: South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175 on Thursday requiring new registered voters to prove that they are United States citizens in order to cast a ballot in state elections. This is a welcome step that restores basic order by ensuring only those with a rightful stake in our nation can participate in choosing its direction. At a time when progressive institutions push to blur the lines of citizenship and weaken national sovereignty, leaders must stand firm on tradition and authority to protect what belongs to Americans. This upholds personal responsibility and cultural continuity, keeping elections focused on the people who built and sustain this country rather than outsiders.
